section.content: The invention provides an AI artificial intelligent machine learning system and an intelligent gateway, which relate to the technical field of AI artificial intelligent control and comprise a communication module, an edge calculation module and a simulation memory area, wherein the communication module establishes bidirectional connection with an air conditioning unit, a security sensor array and an intelligent lighting network in a building through various Internet of things protocols, acquires equipment operation data streams in real time, and comprises an air conditioning compressor current waveform, a security alarm code and lighting equipment light intensity time sequence data, and the edge calculation module is used for extracting air conditioning energy consumption characteristic values, security alarm signals and environment temperature and humidity data sets according to the equipment operation data streams and storing the processed structured data sets into the simulation memory area through a simulation classification algorithm. The invention realizes the real-time acquisition and processing of the data of the multi-source equipment through the cooperation of the multiple modules, analyzes the information of personnel and environment, intelligently generates control instructions, and adapts to various equipment through protocol conversion, thereby improving the environmental comfort, the safety and the energy utilization efficiency of the building and enhancing the compatibility and the emergency response capability of the system.

本发明提供一种AI人工智能机器学习系统及智能网关，涉及AI人工智能控制技术领域，包括：通讯模块，通过多种物联网协议与楼宇内空调机组、安防传感器阵列和智能照明网络建立双向连接，实时采集设备运行数据流，包括空调压缩机电流波形、安防报警代码和照明设备光强时序数据；边缘计算模块，用于根据设备运行数据流，提取空调能耗特征值、安防报警信号和环境温湿度数据集，并通过拟物分类算法将处理后结构化数据集存储至拟物记忆区。本发明有通过多模块协同，实现多源设备数据实时采集与处理，分析人员与环境信息，智能生成控制指令，经协议转换适配各类设备，从而提升楼宇环境舒适度、安全性与能源利用效率，增强系统兼容性和应急响应能力。

AI artificial intelligence machine learning system and intelligent gatewayTechnical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of AI artificial intelligence control, in particular to an AI artificial intelligence machine learning system and an intelligent gateway.

Background

Traditional internet of things gateways face multiple bottlenecks in building automation scenarios. The traditional architecture adopts a time-division multiplexing mode, relies on a centralized data center to collect and store data, and causes delay in the data collection from building equipment (such as an air conditioning unit and a security sensor) to control instruction issuing.

For example, the air conditioning system needs to dynamically adjust the temperature according to the personnel density, but the traditional link delay causes temperature response lag to influence comfort level and energy efficiency optimization, and the security system can not meet the building security specification requirement due to delay of processing of a middle platform in the cloud after smoke alarm triggering.

In addition, heterogeneous data such as air conditioner current waveforms, security alarm codes and the like cannot be subjected to real-time fusion analysis, digital twinning relies on full data transmission to aggravate network congestion in a building, equipment-level features (such as air conditioner energy efficiency ratio and personnel thermodynamic distribution) cannot be dynamically extracted, so that a control instruction is disjointed from the environment state of the building, sensitive data (such as video monitoring flow) is required to be uploaded to a cloud for processing, privacy leakage risk is increased, and high-bandwidth occupation restricts energy efficiency optimization.

Disclosure of Invention

The technical problem to be solved by the invention is to provide an AI artificial intelligent machine learning system and an intelligent gateway, which realize protocol self-adaptive conversion, data efficient compression and edge end real-time decision.

In order to solve the technical problems, the technical scheme of the invention is as follows:

in a first aspect, an AI artificial intelligence machine learning system includes:

The communication module establishes bidirectional connection with an air conditioning unit, a security sensor array and an intelligent lighting network in a building through various Internet of things protocols, and acquires equipment operation data flow in real time, wherein the equipment operation data flow comprises air conditioning compressor current waveforms, security alarm codes and lighting equipment light intensity time sequence data;

The edge calculation module is used for extracting an air conditioner energy consumption characteristic value, a security alarm signal and an environment temperature and humidity data set according to the equipment operation data stream, and storing the processed structured data set into a simulated object memory area through a simulated object classification algorithm;

The pseudo-object memory area module is used for performing time stamp difference coding on the air conditioner historical power data in the structured data set to form a space-time associated data cube;

The engine module is used for identifying thermodynamic diagram modes of personnel movement in the building according to the space-time associated data cubes in the pseudo object memory area and generating a dynamic temperature control parameter matrix;

When an alarm signal is received, a focusing area and an access control strategy of video monitoring are dynamically adjusted through a three-level priority response mechanism according to the type of the signal;

and the protocol conversion module is used for dynamically converting the control instruction into a target equipment protocol format.

Further, according to the equipment operation data stream, extracting an air conditioner energy consumption characteristic value, a security alarm signal and an environment temperature and humidity data set, and storing the processed structured data set into a pseudo-object memory area through a pseudo-object classification algorithm, wherein the method comprises the following steps:

performing sliding window processing on the original equipment data stream, and dividing the continuous data stream into a plurality of data fragments with equal length;

Extracting an air conditioner energy efficiency characteristic set from a plurality of equal-length data fragments, wherein the air conditioner energy efficiency characteristic set comprises a real-time energy efficiency ratio, a current harmonic distortion rate and a load fluctuation index, and generating an alarm frequency density matrix based on security sensor data so as to obtain a characteristic data set containing air conditioner energy efficiency characteristics and security event space-time distribution information;

and generating a device class classification label from the characteristic data set through a device fingerprint coding algorithm, and mapping the class classification data to the pseudo-object memory area according to the device entity ID.

Further, performing time stamp difference encoding on air conditioner historical power data in the structured dataset to form a space-time associated data cube, comprising:

Extracting air conditioner historical power data from the structured data set, grouping according to the equipment ID and arranging according to the time stamp to form a time sequence power sequence;

Calculating a power difference value and a time interval for each adjacent time stamp pair to form a power difference value coding sequence;

and associating the difference value coding sequence with the geographic coordinates of the equipment to construct a three-dimensional data cube comprising a time dimension, a space dimension and a feature dimension.

Further, identifying thermodynamic patterns of personnel movement in the building according to the space-time associated data cubes in the pseudo memory area, and generating a dynamic temperature control parameter matrix, wherein the dynamic temperature control parameter matrix comprises the following components:

Extracting multi-source probe positioning data from a space-time associated data cube in a pseudo memory area, processing the probe positioning data by utilizing a long-short-period memory network, predicting personnel residence probability in a period of time in the future of each area, and generating a dynamic thermal distribution map;

Carrying out space superposition analysis on the thermal distribution diagram and the temperature and humidity gradient data stored in the pseudo-object memory area, and identifying a personnel-intensive area and an environment parameter abnormal area to obtain a coupling analysis result;

And according to the coupling analysis result, combining the thermal response characteristic of the air conditioning unit, and dynamically calculating a regional temperature set value matrix.

Further, extracting probe positioning data from a space-time associated data cube in a pseudo memory area, processing the probe positioning data by using a long-term and short-term memory network, predicting personnel residence probability in a period of time in the future of each area, and generating a dynamic thermal distribution diagram, wherein the method comprises the following steps:

extracting multi-source probe positioning data from a space-time associated data cube of a pseudo memory area, wherein the multi-source probe positioning data comprises probe connection events, bluetooth beacon scanning records and video analysis coordinate point clouds;

Grouping the multi-source probe positioning data according to personnel ID, constructing a space-time sequence of an individual moving track, and dividing the space-time sequence into continuous track fragments through a sliding window;

inputting the track segments into a pre-trained long-term and short-term memory network, and predicting personnel residence probability distribution of each region in a future target period according to a historical movement rule;

And (3) performing spatial interpolation optimization on the residence probability distribution, and generating a dynamic thermodynamic distribution diagram by combining a building topological structure.

Further, according to the coupling analysis result, combining the thermal response characteristic of the air conditioning unit, dynamically calculating a temperature set value matrix of the sub-region, including:

according to historical temperature data in a building, determining a dynamic reference temperature, and comparing the personnel residence probability of each area in a future target period with the actual personnel residence probability of the current time point to obtain a personnel density change rate;

According to the thermal response characteristics of the air conditioning equipment, including response speed, an adjusting range and historical energy efficiency data, including energy consumption and refrigerating capacity, optimizing a personnel thermal load adjusting factor by adopting a self-adaptive learning algorithm;

Collecting outdoor environment humidity monitoring values and weather forecast data in real time, and generating external disturbance compensation factors by combining thermal inertia parameters of an air conditioning unit, including heat capacity and heat conduction values;

And carrying out multidimensional fusion on the reference temperature, the personnel heat load adjustment factor and the disturbance compensation factor to generate a temperature control parameter matrix of the space partition.

Further, generating a control instruction according to environmental comfort index, personnel intensive area distribution, abnormal behavior pattern recognition and security threat level, and dynamically adjusting a focusing area and an access control strategy of video monitoring according to a signal type when an alarm signal is received by a three-level priority response mechanism, wherein the method comprises the following steps:

Performing space-time alignment and confidence weighting fusion on environmental temperature and humidity comfort indexes, a thermodynamic diagram of a personnel-intensive area, video analysis abnormal behavior characteristics and security sensor alarm signals to generate comprehensive threat assessment scores;

triggering a three-level response mechanism according to the comprehensive threat assessment score, and generating a corresponding hierarchical response strategy according to the triggered response level, wherein the hierarchical response strategy comprises a video monitoring focusing area coordinate set, an entrance guard locking logic rule and an air conditioner air volume adjusting parameter;

The hierarchical response strategy is converted into a control instruction set in a target equipment protocol format, and the control instruction set is issued to corresponding equipment through a corresponding communication protocol to execute corresponding operations, including adjusting air conditioner air quantity, adjusting monitoring camera visual angle and controlling door control electromagnetic locking.

Further, the three-level response mechanism includes:

the first-level response is to activate target area access locking and laser tracking video focusing when the comprehensive threat assessment score is more than 90;

Secondary response, namely when the comprehensive threat assessment score is less than or equal to 90 and the comprehensive threat assessment score is less than or equal to 70, starting strobe illumination and directional sound wave alarm of the evacuation channel;

And the three-stage response is that when the comprehensive threat assessment score is less than or equal to 70, the non-core production equipment, including the cooling water circulating pump set and the ventilation auxiliary unit, is switched to the energy-saving mode.

In a second aspect, an intelligent gateway includes:

One or more processors;

and a storage device for storing one or more programs that, when executed by the one or more processors, cause the one or more processors to implement the system.

In a third aspect, a computer readable storage medium has a program stored therein, which when executed by a processor, implements the system.

The scheme of the invention at least comprises the following beneficial effects:

the communication module supports various Internet of things protocols and can quickly and stably establish bidirectional connection with various devices in a building. The system can collect the running data flow of multi-source equipment such as the current waveform of the air conditioner compressor, security alarm codes, light intensity time sequence data of the lighting equipment and the like in real time, avoid data collection barriers caused by protocol incompatibility and ensure the timeliness and the integrity of the data. The edge computing module performs advanced processing on the acquired data by using a pseudo-object classification algorithm, accurately extracts key information such as an air conditioner energy consumption characteristic value, a security alarm signal, an environment temperature and humidity data set and the like, and converts the key information into structural data to be stored in a pseudo-object memory area. Meanwhile, the pseudo-object memory area carries out time stamp difference value coding on the air conditioner historical power data to form a space-time associated data cube, so that the data storage efficiency is improved, and the data retrieval and analysis are facilitated.

The engine module can accurately identify thermodynamic diagram modes of personnel movement in a building based on space-time associated data cubes of the pseudo-object memory area and generate a dynamic temperature control parameter matrix, so that an air conditioning system can intelligently adjust the temperature of each area according to personnel distribution and activity rules, and the energy consumption is effectively reduced while the personnel comfort level is improved. For example, the refrigeration is automatically enhanced in areas with dense personnel, and the temperature is properly increased in areas with sparse personnel. The control logic module generates a control instruction according to the environmental comfort index, the personnel intensive area distribution, the abnormal behavior pattern recognition and the security threat level, and handles security threats of different degrees through a three-level priority response mechanism. When an alarm signal is received, the video monitoring focusing area and the access control strategy can be dynamically adjusted rapidly according to the signal type. If the first-level response locks the dangerous area entrance guard in time and accurately monitors, the second-level response guides evacuation through stroboscopic illumination and directional sound waves, so that the safety protection capability and emergency treatment efficiency of the building are enhanced, and the life and property safety of personnel is guaranteed.

The protocol conversion module can dynamically convert the control instruction into a target equipment protocol format, so that the instruction generated by the system can be suitable for equipment of different brands and different models within accessory block Yuan. Whether the intelligent lighting equipment is an air conditioning unit, security equipment or intelligent lighting equipment, the intelligent lighting equipment can accurately receive and execute the instructions, the problem of control failure caused by equipment protocol difference is avoided, the universality and compatibility of the system are improved, and the cost and difficulty of equipment replacement and upgrading are reduced.

Detailed Description

Exemplary embodiments of the present disclosure will be described in more detail below with reference to the accompanying drawings. While exemplary embodiments of the present disclosure are shown in the drawings, it should be understood that the present disclosure may be embodied in various forms and should not be limited to the embodiments set forth herein. Rather, these embodiments are provided so that this disclosure will be thorough and complete, and will fully convey the scope of the disclosure to those skilled in the art.

As shown in fig. 1, an embodiment of the present invention proposes an AI artificial intelligence machine learning system including:

the communication module 1 establishes bidirectional connection with an air conditioning unit, a security sensor array and an intelligent lighting network in a building through various Internet of things protocols, and acquires equipment operation data flow in real time, wherein the equipment operation data flow comprises air conditioning compressor current waveforms, security alarm codes and lighting equipment light intensity time sequence data;

The edge calculation module 2 is used for extracting an air conditioner energy consumption characteristic value, a security alarm signal and an environment temperature and humidity data set according to the equipment operation data stream, and storing the processed structured data set into a simulated object memory area through a simulated object classification algorithm;

The pseudo-object memory area module 3 is used for performing time stamp difference coding on the air conditioner historical power data in the structured data set to form a space-time associated data cube;

The engine module 4 is used for identifying thermodynamic diagram modes of personnel movement in the building according to the space-time associated data cubes in the pseudo object memory area and generating a dynamic temperature control parameter matrix;

The control logic module 5 is used for generating control instructions according to environmental comfort indexes, personnel intensive area distribution, abnormal behavior pattern recognition and security threat level, and dynamically adjusting a focusing area and an access control strategy of video monitoring according to a three-level priority response mechanism when an alarm signal is received;

the protocol conversion module 6 is configured to dynamically convert the control instruction into a target device protocol format.

In the embodiment of the invention, the end-to-end closed-loop control of building equipment data from acquisition to decision is realized through the localization data processing of the edge computing module and the time-space associated data aggregation of the pseudo-object memory area, the delay of a data link in a traditional architecture is reduced, and the real-time response capability of air conditioner temperature control and security linkage is ensured. Based on a quasi-object classification algorithm and an equipment fingerprint coding technology, multi-source heterogeneous data such as air conditioner current waveforms, security alarm codes and the like are stored according to equipment entity classification, so that the low-efficiency bottleneck of traditional 'point type' storage is broken through, and the data reading and writing efficiency and the multi-equipment collaborative analysis capability are improved.

The differential temperature control strategy of the personnel intensive area and the low-load area in the building is realized by identifying the personnel thermodynamic diagram mode through the AI/ML engine and dynamically generating a regional temperature control parameter matrix by combining the environmental temperature and humidity data, and the energy efficiency optimization and the comfort level requirement are considered. The protocol conversion module supports multi-protocol dynamic adaptation (such as Modbus, zigbee, DALI) to eliminate manual configuration cost, and the control logic module triggers a three-level priority response mechanism based on multi-dimensional data fusion such as environmental comfort level, security threat level and the like to realize intelligent linkage of security, illumination and air conditioning systems.

And sensitive data (such as security alarm signals) finish feature extraction and compression processing at the edge end, and only the structured analysis result is uploaded to the cloud through the space-time associated data cube, so that the privacy leakage risk is reduced, and the network bandwidth occupation is reduced. The design of the space-time associated data cube and the pseudo memory area supports the rapid backtracking and predictive analysis of the historical data of the building equipment, provides a light-weight data base for digital twin, and simultaneously reduces the software and hardware cost of system capacity expansion.

In a preferred embodiment of the present invention, extracting an air conditioner energy consumption characteristic value, a security alarm signal and an environmental temperature and humidity data set, and storing the processed structured data set in a pseudo-object memory area through a pseudo-object classification algorithm may include:

performing sliding window processing on the original equipment data stream, and dividing the continuous data stream into a plurality of data fragments with equal length;

Extracting an air conditioner energy efficiency characteristic set from a plurality of equal-length data fragments, wherein the air conditioner energy efficiency characteristic set comprises a real-time energy efficiency ratio, a current harmonic distortion rate and a load fluctuation index, and generating an alarm frequency density matrix based on security sensor data so as to obtain a characteristic data set containing air conditioner energy efficiency characteristics and security event space-time distribution information;

and generating a device class classification label from the characteristic data set through a device fingerprint coding algorithm, and mapping the class classification data to the pseudo-object memory area according to the device entity ID.

In the embodiment of the invention, the original data stream (such as continuous current waveform of an air conditioner compressor, alarm code stream of a security sensor and time sequence light intensity data of the lighting equipment) generated by the air conditioner, security and lighting equipment is dynamically segmented. The data stream is cut using a fixed time window (e.g., 5 seconds) or an adaptive event window (e.g., every 1000 data points) to ensure that each data segment contains a complete event period (e.g., one start-stop period of the air conditioning compressor). A device ID, a time stamp, and a spatial tag (e.g., floor location) are attached to each data segment to ensure the spatiotemporal alignment of the multi-device data. For example, the air conditioning current segment is strictly synchronized with the temperature and humidity data of the area where it is located.

Calculating EER value (refrigerating capacity/power) based on instantaneous power (current×voltage) of the current segment and a preset refrigerating capacity mapping tableReflecting the current energy efficiency state, wherein,The refrigerating capacity is obtained from a preset mapping table and is related to current, voltage and equipment model; Is the current; Is a voltage. Performing Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) on the current waveform, extracting fundamental wave and each subharmonic component, and calculating total harmonic distortion rate The current quality is evaluated, wherein,Is the highest harmonic order; Is the harmonic order; Is the first An effective value of the subharmonic voltage; is the effective value (RMS) of the fundamental voltage, i.e., the voltage amplitude of the primary frequency (power frequency, e.g., 50Hz/60 Hz) component of the signal. And counting a current peak Gu Chazhi in the window, and quantifying the running stability of the compressor by combining the standard deviation of the historical load data. A two-dimensional matrix is constructed by counting the frequency of alarm events for a spatial region (e.g., room, corridor) and a time window (e.g., every 10 minutes). For example, a matrix row represents an area, a column represents a time window, and an element value is the number of alarms of the area in the corresponding time window.

And carrying out hash coding on static parameters (such as model and installation position) of the equipment, and generating unique equipment fingerprint labels through a lightweight classification model (such as a decision tree) by combining dynamic characteristics (such as THD average value and alarm frequency mode). And classifying and storing the characteristic data set (such as air conditioner energy efficiency characteristics and security alarm matrixes) into independent data units according to the equipment entity ID. For example, the data unit of air conditioning unit ID-A contains a historical EER sequence, THD trends, and associated environmental parameters, forming a device-centric semantically stored structure.

For example, the air conditioning and security system of a commercial building is optimized, the air conditioning unit generates a current waveform data stream every 5 seconds, and the sliding window divides the current waveform data stream into continuous segments, wherein each segment contains 20 current period data.

The security sensor reports alarm codes (such as smoke alarm and intrusion detection) in real time, and the alarm times of each floor are counted according to the time window of every 10 minutes. And calculating EER values from the current segments, and finding that the EER value of the floor air conditioner No. 3 is continuously lower than a threshold value, and triggering energy efficiency alarm. The security alarm matrix displays that the alarm frequency of the area B is abnormally increased in the peak period, and the area B is judged to be a false alarm high-emission area by combining historical data. The THD characteristic of the No. 3 air conditioner is compared with the historical data to generate a unique fingerprint, the unique fingerprint is mapped to the independent unit of the pseudo memory area, and the installation position and the maintenance record of the unique fingerprint are associated. The security alarm matrix is associated with the air conditioner operation data according to the time stamp to form a multi-dimensional analysis view of 'region-time-equipment'.

The second-level detection and response of the air conditioner energy efficiency abnormality (such as EER dip) are realized through the sliding window and the edge feature extraction, so that the minute-level delay of the traditional architecture is avoided. The device fingerprint code maps discrete current waveforms and alarm codes into a semantic data set with the device as a core, and supports association analysis of cross-devices (such as air conditioning and security protection). Based on coupling analysis of security alarm matrix and air conditioner energy efficiency characteristics, automatically switching the air conditioner to a low power consumption mode in a security high-emission area, and balancing energy efficiency and emergency response requirements. The space-time associated data cube compresses historical data through differential value coding, storage redundancy is reduced, the device-level classification labels simplify data query logic, and database load is reduced. The device fingerprint code is compatible with multi-protocol devices (such as Modbus air conditioner and Zigbee sensor), avoids manual configuration rules, and is suitable for accessory block Yu complex device environments.

In a preferred embodiment of the present invention, performing time stamp difference encoding on air conditioner historical power data in a structured dataset to form a space-time associated data cube may include:

Extracting air conditioner historical power data from the structured data set, grouping according to the equipment ID and arranging according to the time stamp to form a time sequence power sequence;

Calculating a power difference value and a time interval for each adjacent time stamp pair to form a power difference value coding sequence;

and associating the difference value coding sequence with the geographic coordinates of the equipment to construct a three-dimensional data cube comprising a time dimension, a space dimension and a feature dimension.

In an embodiment of the invention, air conditioner historical power data is extracted from a structured database, and data fields comprise equipment IDs, time stamps, power values and equipment geographic coordinates (such as floors and room numbers). Each group of data is arranged in ascending order of time stamp according to the device ID group, and a time sequence power sequence of each device is formed. And (5) associating the difference value coding sequence with equipment geographic coordinates (such as longitude and latitude and floor coordinates) to form a data unit with a space tag.

The time dimension is divided by time windows (such as hours and days), and the time distribution of the difference sequence is recorded;

space dimension, namely dividing areas (such as rooms and floors) according to equipment coordinates, and aggregating difference data of the equipment in the areas;

With columnar stores (e.g., parquet format), fast time, space, or device ID range queries are supported.

Suppose that the original power sequence for a particular office air conditioner energy consumption analysis is (09:00, 1500 w), (09:15, 1500 w), (09:30, 1650 w) for device ID-a (3-floor conference room air conditioner). The original power sequence for device ID-B (5 floor corridor air conditioner) was (09:00, 800 w), (09:15, 750 w), (09:30, 820 w). The difference sequence of the equipment ID-A is%=300W,=900s),(=-150W,=900 S). The difference sequence of the equipment ID-B is%=-50W,=900s),(=70W,=900s)...。

feature dimension is the power trend (e.g., ID-A "fast rise and fall", ID-B "smooth wave").

And the full storage is replaced by the difference value coding, only the initial value and the variation are reserved, and the storage redundancy of the historical data is obviously reduced. For example, the original 1000 power records may be compressed to 1 initial value +999 difference values. The data cube supports multidimensional joint queries such as space dimension, time dimension, characteristic dimension and characteristic dimension, wherein the space dimension is used for counting power fluctuation modes of all air conditioners at a certain floor, the time dimension is used for analyzing energy efficiency change trend of peak time (such as 12:00-14:00), and the characteristic dimension is used for identifying abnormal fluctuation of a specific equipment type (such as variable-frequency air conditioner). The difference value coding allows the power value at any time point to be restored quickly, and the real-time monitoring and historical data backtracking requirements are met. By power difference distribution in the space-time cube, abnormal region (such as a floor can be rapidly positionedContinuously negative), and judging the source of the fault by combining the equipment coordinates. The space-time correlation analysis reveals regional energy consumption rules (such as meeting room air conditioners still running at high power in unmanned time periods), and provides a data basis for automatic scheduling strategies (such as adjusting temperature according to people flow).

In a preferred embodiment of the present invention, identifying thermodynamic patterns of personnel movements within a building based on spatio-temporal associated data cubes in a pseudo-object memory area, generating a dynamic temperature control parameter matrix may include:

Extracting multi-source probe positioning data from a space-time associated data cube in a pseudo memory area, processing the probe positioning data by utilizing a long-short-period memory network, predicting personnel residence probability in a period of time in the future of each area, and generating a dynamic thermal distribution map;

Carrying out space superposition analysis on the thermal distribution diagram and the temperature and humidity gradient data stored in the pseudo-object memory area, and identifying a personnel-intensive area and an environment parameter abnormal area to obtain a coupling analysis result;

And according to the coupling analysis result, combining the thermal response characteristic of the air conditioning unit, and dynamically calculating a regional temperature set value matrix.

In an embodiment of the invention, wi-Fi probes (device connection time, signal strength), bluetooth beacons (device scan records), video coordinate point clouds (personnel real-time positions), time stamps are extracted from a spatio-temporal correlation data cube, and noise data (such as signal drift points) are aligned and cleaned. The multi-source data is associated with a device ID or anonymous identifier (e.g., hashed MAC address) to generate a time-stamped individual movement trajectory (e.g., path and dwell time of the user from the hall to the conference room). The track is divided into segments according to a sliding window (such as 15 minutes), features (stay point density and moving direction change rate) are extracted, and a pre-trained LSTM model is input to predict the residence probability of personnel in each area in a future period (such as 85% of the probability of the next hour of a conference room).

Mapping the prediction probability to a building plane grid (1 m multiplied by 1 m), filling a blank area through the Kriging interpolation, and generating a color gradient thermodynamic diagram (red high density and blue low density) by combining the topological structure correction distribution of walls, door access and the like. And (3) extracting real-time temperature and humidity gradient data (sampled every 5 minutes) stored in the pseudo memory area, and aligning with a thermodynamic diagram according to the same grid granularity to form a multidimensional data layer (thermal +temperature and humidity +air conditioning state). And (3) performing spatial superposition operation on the dynamic thermal distribution map and the temperature and humidity gradient data by using a Geographic Information System (GIS) technology. In the superposition process, the personnel residence probability of each region in the thermodynamic diagram is correlated and matched with the temperature and humidity data of the corresponding position. And identifying a personnel-intensive area (an area with personnel residence probability higher than the threshold) and an environment parameter abnormal area (an area with temperature or humidity exceeding the normal range) by setting a personnel residence probability threshold (such as 0.7) and a normal temperature and humidity range (the temperature is 22-26 ℃ and the humidity is 40-60%).

For each area within the building (e.g., offices, conference rooms, hallways, etc. of different floors), a suitable temperature set point is calculated using a formula (dynamic reference temperature x person thermal load adjustment factor x disturbance compensation factor). The temperature set values of all the areas are arranged into a matrix form to form a regional temperature set value matrix, and specific parameters are provided for accurate temperature control of the air conditioning system.

Assume that a large mall is provided, and the mall has three layers, and each layer has a plurality of shops and public areas.

In the afternoon of weekends, connection information of a large number of customers is collected through the Wi-Fi probe, the Bluetooth beacons also scan movement tracks of a large number of customers, and the video monitoring system records coordinate point clouds of the customers in all areas. After cleaning and integrating the data, individual movement track space-time sequences are constructed according to the customer ID group. For example, customer A enters from the entrance of one floor, passes through several clothing stores, and then goes to the restaurant of the second floor between 2 and 3 pm. This spatio-temporal sequence is segmented into segments using a sliding window, e.g. a 2-point to 2-point 15-point movement trajectory is used as a segment. These segments were entered into the LSTM network and it was predicted that within the next 1 hour, the three-layer theatre and the one-layer dessert area would have a higher personnel residence probability, while the two-layer partial store personnel residence probability was lower.

And (3) performing spatial interpolation optimization on the prediction result, and generating a dynamic thermal distribution diagram by combining floor layout of a market. In the figure, the theatre and dessert areas are shown in red, indicating that people are dense, and some shops are shown in blue, indicating that people are rare. The temperature and humidity gradient data in the market are obtained from the simulated memory area, and the temperature and humidity gradient data of the cinema are found to be higher than the surrounding area by 3 ℃ due to the fact that the cinema is dense in personnel, the humidity is increased to some extent, and the dessert area is slightly higher in temperature and higher in humidity due to the fact that personnel frequently go and come. And determining the areas of intensive personnel and abnormal environmental parameters in the cinema and dessert areas through space superposition analysis. Coupling analysis results show that these areas require temperature and humidity adjustment. In another preferred embodiment of the present invention, extracting probe positioning data from a space-time associated data cube in a pseudo memory area, and processing the probe positioning data by using a long-short term memory network, predicting a residence probability of a person in each area for a period of time in the future, and generating a dynamic thermal distribution map may include:

extracting multi-source probe positioning data from a space-time associated data cube of a pseudo memory area, wherein the multi-source probe positioning data comprises probe connection events, bluetooth beacon scanning records and video analysis coordinate point clouds;

Grouping the multi-source probe positioning data according to personnel ID, constructing a space-time sequence of an individual moving track, and dividing the space-time sequence into continuous track fragments through a sliding window;

inputting the track segments into a pre-trained long-term and short-term memory network, and predicting personnel residence probability distribution of each region in a future target period according to a historical movement rule;

And (3) performing spatial interpolation optimization on the residence probability distribution, and generating a dynamic thermodynamic distribution diagram by combining a building topological structure.

In the embodiment of the invention, the pseudo-object memory area is an area for storing processed data, and the space-time associated data cube integrates multi-dimensional information such as time, space, equipment and the like. The probe connection event records the connection establishment time and related information of equipment (such as a mobile phone) and a probe, and can be used for judging the occurrence of personnel in the coverage area of the probe, the Bluetooth beacon scanning record comprises Bluetooth signal intensity, scanning time and the like, the relative position of the personnel and a Bluetooth beacon can be roughly determined, and the video analysis coordinate point cloud is used for obtaining the accurate coordinate information of the personnel in a scene by carrying out image analysis on a monitoring video. The system screens out the multi-source probe positioning data in a specific time period from the space-time associated data cube through a preset data extraction rule and interface. For example, relevant data from 9 am to 11 am on a certain workday are extracted, and required probe connection events, bluetooth beacon scanning records and video analysis coordinate point cloud data are accurately acquired according to the time range and the identification of the data types.

After the multi-source probe positioning data is acquired, the data is grouped according to a person ID (e.g., a unique identifier of the device) contained in the data. The ID of each person corresponds to a group of data, and the data are arranged according to a time sequence to construct a space-time sequence of the individual movement track. This sequence details the position information of each person at different points in time, reflecting their movement trajectories. The spatio-temporal sequence is then partitioned using a sliding window technique. The sliding window has a fixed length of time (e.g., 10 minutes) and a sliding step (e.g., 1 minute), starting at the start time of the sequence, and each time moving by one step, the data within the fixed length of time period is truncated to form a number of consecutive track segments. For example, for a person's spatio-temporal sequence, the segmentation is performed in 10 minutes as a window length and 1 minute as a step, the first segment may be movement trajectory data from 9 points to 9 points 10 minutes, the second segment may be data from 9 points 1 to 9 points 11 minutes, and so on.

Long and short term memory networks (LSTM) are a type of neural network dedicated to processing time series data that is capable of learning long term dependencies and complex patterns in the data. Before use, the LSTM network needs to be trained with a large amount of historical track segment data. In the training process, the network learners move in different time periods and different areas in a mode and a rule. After training is completed, the segmented track segments are input into a pre-trained LSTM network. The network analyzes and predicts the input track segments according to the learned historical movement rules and outputs the personnel residence probability distribution of each area in the future target period (such as 30 minutes in the future). For example, the network may predict that the elevator hoistway zone personnel residence probability for a floor is 0.6, the restaurant zone personnel residence probability is 0.3, etc. within 30 minutes of the future.

The predicted personnel residence probability distribution is a discrete data point, and spatial interpolation optimization is needed for more intuitively and continuously displaying personnel distribution conditions. The spatial interpolation algorithm (such as inverse distance weighted interpolation, kriging interpolation, etc.) estimates probability values of other locations over the entire spatial range based on known discrete probability data points, making the probability distribution smoother and more continuous. Meanwhile, the probability value is mapped to the actual space position by combining the topological structure information (such as floor layout, room position and size, channel trend and the like) of the building. Different colors (e.g., red for high probability, blue for low probability) and shades of colors are used to represent the level of the personnel retention probability for different regions, thereby generating dynamic thermal profiles. Thus, the density and distribution trend of people in different areas of the building at a certain time period in the future can be clearly seen through thermodynamic diagrams.

Assume that there is a large office building, 5 floors, each floor having multiple offices, conference rooms, and public areas.

Data is extracted from the spatiotemporal associative data cube of the pseudo memory area at 10 to 12 am on a workday. The method comprises the steps of acquiring connection information of a plurality of staff devices and probes distributed on each floor at different times through probe connection events, displaying the activity condition of staff near a Bluetooth beacon by Bluetooth beacon scanning records, and accurately recording the positions of the staff in a monitoring range by video analysis of coordinate point cloud. For example, employee a's cell phone establishes a connection with a probe located near the hoistway of floor 3 at 10 o' clock 15 while the bluetooth beacon scans to its presence in the area and the video analysis coordinate point cloud determines its specific coordinate location. These data are grouped according to employee's job number (as person ID), and an individual movement track space-time sequence for each employee is constructed. For example, employee a, from 10 to 10 points for 30 minutes, whose trajectory is shown from the office of floor 3, through the corridor to the conference room. Using a sliding window, the window length is set to 10 minutes and the step size is 1 minute, and this spatio-temporal sequence is segmented into segments. The first segment is a 10-point to 10-point trajectory, the second segment is a 10-point 1-point to 10-point 11-point trajectory, etc.

These segmented track segments are input into a pre-trained LSTM network. The network has already trained a large amount of historical movement data of staff of the office building before, has learned the movement law of the staff. Through network analysis, the area personnel residence probability of the tea room of the building 4 is predicted to be 0.7 in the future 30 minutes, because the time period is usually the rest time of staff, more people can go to the tea room, and the personnel residence probability of a small conference room of the building 5 is predicted to be 0.2, because the conference room has no conference arrangement in the same day. And (3) performing spatial interpolation optimization on the predicted personnel residence probability distribution, so that the probability distribution is smoother. The probability values are mapped to the corresponding areas in combination with the floor layout of the office building. On the generated dynamic thermodynamic distribution diagram, the tea water area of the building 4 is shown in dark red, the standing probability of the representative person is high, the small conference room of the building 5 is shown in light blue, the standing probability of the representative person is low, other areas also show different degrees of color shades according to respective probability values, and the personnel distribution trend of each area of the office building in the future 30 minutes is intuitively shown.

Through dynamic thermal distribution diagram, manager can clearly know the future personnel flow trend and the intensity of different areas. For office buildings, working time such as cleaning and maintenance can be reasonably arranged according to thermodynamic diagrams, the influence of working in a personnel intensive period on normal office of staff is avoided, for a market, a promotion activity area can be planned in advance, and activities are arranged in areas with large personnel flow, so that activity effects and commercial benefits are improved.

According to the personnel residence probability distribution, more reasonable configuration can be carried out on the resources. The power or the starting quantity of the air conditioner, the lighting and other equipment is increased in the area with dense personnel, the comfortable environment is ensured, the running power of the equipment is properly reduced in the area with sparse personnel, and the energy is saved. For example, in a office building, the air conditioner may be turned on in advance and adjusted to a proper temperature according to thermodynamic diagrams in a meeting room where people are concentrated, while part of the lighting devices are turned off at floors where people are fewer. The dynamic thermal profile aids in safety management.

When the personnel residence probability of a certain area is found to be abnormally high or abnormally low, the personnel residence probability can be checked and processed in time. If a prediction situation of dense personnel suddenly appears in a region with rare personnel at ordinary times in an office building, potential safety hazards possibly exist, security personnel can go forward to check in advance, and in a market, the region with the possibility of congestion or abnormal aggregation can be timely found, and the security of the personnel is guaranteed by adopting dredging measures in advance. Providing powerful support for operational decisions. If the market can analyze the attractive force of different areas and the flow rule of customers according to thermodynamic diagrams, the layout and the commodity display of the store can be adjusted, the shopping experience and the purchasing desire of the customers can be improved, and the office building manager can reasonably plan a new office area or adjust the use mode of the existing space according to personnel distribution conditions, so that the space utilization rate can be improved.

In a preferred embodiment of the invention, a control command is generated according to environmental comfort index, personnel intensive area distribution, abnormal behavior pattern recognition and security threat level, and when an alarm signal is received, a focusing area and an entrance guard control strategy of video monitoring are dynamically adjusted through a three-level priority response mechanism according to the signal type, which can comprise:

Performing space-time alignment and confidence weighting fusion on environmental temperature and humidity comfort indexes, a thermodynamic diagram of a personnel-intensive area, video analysis abnormal behavior characteristics and security sensor alarm signals to generate comprehensive threat assessment scores;

Triggering a three-level response mechanism according to the comprehensive threat assessment score, and generating a corresponding hierarchical response strategy according to the triggered response level, wherein the hierarchical response strategy comprises a video monitoring focusing area coordinate set, an entrance guard locking logic rule and an air conditioner air volume adjusting parameter, and the three-level response mechanism comprises:

the first-level response is to activate target area access locking and laser tracking video focusing when the comprehensive threat assessment score is more than 90;

Secondary response, namely when the comprehensive threat assessment score is less than or equal to 90 and the comprehensive threat assessment score is less than or equal to 70, starting strobe illumination and directional sound wave alarm of the evacuation channel;

Three-stage response, namely switching non-core production equipment comprising a cooling water circulating pump set and a ventilation auxiliary unit to an energy-saving mode when the comprehensive threat assessment score is less than or equal to 70;

The hierarchical response strategy is converted into a control instruction set in a target equipment protocol format, and the control instruction set is issued to corresponding equipment through a corresponding communication protocol to execute corresponding operations, including adjusting air conditioner air quantity, adjusting monitoring camera visual angle and controlling door control electromagnetic locking.

In the embodiment of the invention, the temperature and humidity sensors are deployed in each key area (such as offices, hallways, conference rooms and the like) of the building. These sensors collect environmental temperature and humidity data at certain time intervals (e.g., every minute) and the data is transmitted to a central control system in real time. For example, in an office, a temperature and humidity sensor records the current temperature as 26 ℃ and the humidity as 50%. The Wi-Fi probe is realized by means of multiple positioning technologies, the position of a person is estimated through the MAC address and the signal intensity of the detection equipment, the Bluetooth beacon is used for more accurate close-range positioning by utilizing Bluetooth signals, and the video monitoring system is used for detecting and counting the person in a monitoring picture through an image recognition algorithm. The personnel position information of different sources is integrated, a special algorithm is used for generating a personnel-intensive area thermodynamic diagram, and the personnel distribution density of different areas is intuitively displayed. As in a mall, it is found by these techniques that the staff density is higher in a certain layer of the restaurant, and that this area is displayed in a darker color on the thermodynamic diagram.

The video monitoring system uses a computer vision technology to analyze the monitoring video frame by frame. Abnormal behaviors such as running of people, long-time static in sensitive areas, aggregation of multiple people and the like are identified through a preset behavior model. For example, when it is detected that a person suddenly starts running in a counter area of a bank, the video analysis system extracts relevant features of the behavior, including information about the time, location, number of persons involved, etc. that the behavior occurs, and marks it as an abnormal behavior. Various security sensors, such as intrusion detection sensors, smoke sensors, emergency buttons and the like, are installed at important positions (such as entrances and exits, machine rooms, warehouses and the like) of a building. An alarm signal is sent to the central control system immediately upon detection of an abnormal condition by the sensor. For example, when the intrusion detection sensor detects an intruder, a signal containing information of an intrusion position, an alarm type, and the like is transmitted.

Because these data come from different devices and systems, their acquisition times and frequencies may not be consistent, and thus require space-time alignment. And calibrating the data time stamps of different data sources by taking a high-precision clock source (such as an atomic clock or a network time server) as a reference, so as to ensure that all data have consistency in time. Meanwhile, different types of data are matched with specific physical positions according to the installation position and the monitoring range of the equipment. For example, temperature and humidity sensor data in a certain room of a certain floor, abnormal behavior data captured by a monitoring camera of the room and alarm signals of a security sensor in the room are all associated with specific coordinate positions of the room, so that the data are corresponding to the same area in time and space.

Confidence is determined for each data source, which is based on factors such as the reliability of the data, the performance of the device, and the accuracy of the historical data. The temperature and humidity sensor with high precision and good stability is endowed with higher confidence coefficient, such as 0.9, and the confidence coefficient of the wireless security sensor which is easy to be interfered by the environment is possibly set to be 0.7. The confidence level of the video analysis system can be set to 0.8 if the video analysis system is trained on a large number of samples and shows high accuracy in practical applications. The confidence level of the thermodynamic diagram of the personnel-intensive area depends on the accuracy of the positioning technology and the timeliness of the data update, and if the positioning is accurate and updated in real time, the confidence level can be set to be 0.85. The system can dynamically adjust the confidence according to the running state of the equipment, the accuracy of the historical data and other factors.

And according to the importance and reliability of each item of data, corresponding weights are allocated to the data. Assuming that the environmental temperature and humidity comfort level index weight is 0.2, the thermodynamic diagram weight of the personnel-intensive area is 0.3, the abnormal behavior characteristic weight of the video analysis is 0.3, and the alarm signal weight of the security sensor is 0.2. Before fusion calculation, each item of data is standardized, and is converted into a unified numerical range (such as 0-1) so as to eliminate the difference of different data types in dimension. Normalization may be performed by, for example, passing the temperature data through a formulaNormalization is performed in whichIs the original data of the data set,AndRespectively the minimum and maximum of the data type. And then calculating comprehensive threat assessment scores according to a weighted formula, wherein the comprehensive threat assessment scores=0.2×environmental temperature and humidity comfort level index standardization value+0.3×personnel intensive area thermodynamic diagram standardization value+0.3×video analysis abnormal behavior characteristic standardization value+0.2×security sensor alarm signal standardization value.

Threshold setting:

First order response (> 90) corresponds to high risk event (such as a fire break-in) requiring immediate physical isolation and accurate tracking.

And secondary responses (70-90) corresponding to medium risk events (such as personnel gathering conflict and local smoke) and needing evacuation guidance and warning.

And the third-level response (less than or equal to 70) is to switch the equipment to the energy-saving mode under low risk or energy efficiency optimization conditions (such as off-peak time).

And (3) adjusting the air conditioner, namely closing a fresh air system to prevent smoke from diffusing and increasing the exhaust air quantity to the maximum gear.

Second-level response strategy:

evacuation guidance, namely strobe illumination (500 Hz flicker frequency) and directional sound waves (145 dB directional alarm) of triggering evacuation channels.

And (3) video monitoring, namely adjusting cameras to a preset evacuation route visual angle (such as corridor and stairway), and enabling crowd density analysis.

Three-stage response strategy:

The equipment is energy-saving, namely, non-core equipment (such as a cooling water pump) is switched to a low-frequency operation mode (30% of power), and the ventilator unit operates according to the minimum ventilation quantity.

The focus coordinates (e.g., XYZ coordinates) are converted to PTZ control instructions (< ContinuousMove > commands) in the ONVIF protocol format.

And the access control system generates a Wiegand protocol or an IP instruction.

The air conditioning system is converted into Modbus RTU instruction (for example, register address 0x4001 is written, and air quantity value is set to 80%).

And the transmission channel is preempted by the high-priority instruction (such as primary response) through the asynchronous transmission instruction of the MQTT message queue. The instruction state is recorded by using the transaction log, and the automatic retry (such as 3 retries and artificial alarm) is performed when the failure occurs.
